original_test_intent: Run the approved NVQual ConnectX/BlueField thermal workload on the mapped device and network topology and prove temperatures, power, throttling, link/fabric integrity, and device/host health satisfy the project limits for the defined load, duration, ambient, and cooling conditions.
original_method: Pin the licensed NVQual NT.3 recipe, device/port/peer/fabric identity, traffic/load phases, duration, ambient/cooling state, sensor mapping, sample cadence, thermal/power/throttling/link limits, and abort/recovery plan; capture synchronized baseline and per-phase telemetry; stop at first limit or health fault; cease traffic, cool down, restore policy/interfaces, and preserve the complete artifact.
manual_activity: Owner/FAE provides the licensed recipe and quantitative limits; an operator confirms cooling/ambient, isolation and emergency response, supervises the thermal run and cooldown, and owns recovery.
required_inputs: Licensed pinned NVQual NT.3 ConnectX/BlueField thermal configuration and compatible firmware/DOCA/driver
Exact DPU/NIC/port/peer/fabric/cable/optics and sensor identity map
Traffic/load phases, rate/direction, duration, ambient/cooling, sampling cadence, and stabilization rules
Temperature/power/throttling/link/error/pass limits, isolation, abort, cooldown, restoration, and recovery contract
safety_requirements: Approved isolated fabric and dedicated or controlled SUT with verified cooling and emergency stop
Authenticated credential handling and trusted host identity; no plaintext sshpass or host-key bypass
Independent temperature/power/cooling monitoring with conservative first-limit abort
Stop on sensor loss, temperature/power limit, out-of-policy throttling, packet loss/link/fabric errors, DPU/host instability, fan/cooling fault, tool failure, or evidence gap
Do not disable protections, extend load, truncate evidence, or retry automatically
agent_execution_scope: Validate licensed recipe, identity/topology, baseline, synchronized collectors, limits, and interlocks
Run only the approved NT.3 load and phases after operator confirmation
Stop traffic and assist approved cooldown/restoration on first fault
Do not expose credentials, invent commands/limits, bypass protections, retry, or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve NVQual NT.3 recipe, topology, traffic/load, duration, ambient/cooling, sensors, and sample cadence
Define thermal/power/throttling/network acceptance and first-limit aborts
Own cooldown, restoration, fault disposition, and recovery
Review synchronized evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The help command is only a capability check; insecure sshpass, disabled host-key verification, and `head` truncation are unacceptable, and it neither launches nor validates the ConnectX/BlueField thermal workload.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the owner-supplied pinned NT.3 manifest via authenticated trusted access and synchronize the full raw NVQual result with device temperatures, power, throttling, traffic, link/fabric errors, host/BMC health, and ambient/cooling telemetry.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: ConnectX/BlueField Thermal Test, no bundle, and 30/180-minute allocation remain; absent command, topology, load, duration, and limits are not invented.

modernized_recommendation.status: CRITICAL INTERLOCKED CONNECTX BLUEFIELD THERMAL QUALIFICATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build one synchronized timeline across NVQual phase/load, device/sensor identity, ambient/cooling, temperature, power, throttling, traffic, link errors, and host/BMC state, with a hard first-limit stop and verified cooldown.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces a help-only placeholder with a governed thermal experiment and adds secure access, quantitative limits, independent monitoring, complete artifacts, restoration, and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: NVQual launch/pass text alone cannot prove correct topology, sustained load, temperature margin, absence of throttling, or network health throughout the run.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Thermal workload can overheat or throttle DPUs/NICs, disturb shared fabric, and expose cooling or power margins; missing or misbound sensors invalidate the result.

project_override_considerations: Vendor aggregate PASS is acceptable only when the pinned recipe and raw artifact expose the required device, load, duration, sensor, and limit context. A chamber is not assumed unless the project requires it; ambient and cooling must still be measured and bounded.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, owner approval, licensed NVQual version/configuration hash, and secure-access audit
Load/traffic phases, rates, direction, duration, ambient/cooling, sample cadence, and approved limits
Complete synchronized per-phase/per-device temperatures, power, throttling, traffic, link/fabric/error counters, raw NVQual results, and timestamps
BMC/OS/device logs, first-limit/abort/cooldown/restoration records, final health, and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure, and Criteria consistently name the ConnectX/BlueField thermal test, though Criteria is non-quantitative and DeepSeek supplies only a placeholder precheck. The missing test contract is readiness under-specification, not a competing source objective.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The thermal-network objective is identifiable. Licensed tooling, topology, workload, sensor/limit contract, secure access, isolation, monitoring, and recovery are normal execution prerequisites rather than permanent review blockers.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2125 Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00043-V002: approve the licensed pinned NVQual NT.3 ConnectX/BlueField thermal recipe, device/port/peer/fabric/cable/optics and sensor map, traffic/load phases and rates, duration, ambient/cooling and sampling rules, temperature/power/throttling/link/error pass limits, first-limit aborts, cooldown/restoration, and recovery.

review_improvement: Turns a help-only placeholder into a secure, quantitatively bounded thermal/network qualification with synchronized evidence and first-limit safety control while preserving the original test identity.
independent_technical_reasoning: A thermal test is valid only when heat generation, environmental removal capacity, device identity, sensor provenance, and acceptance limits are tied to the same timeline. A vendor pass line cannot show that the intended ports were loaded, sensors were sampled without gaps, throttling remained acceptable, or the fabric stayed healthy. Because the workload itself raises temperature and power, the monitor must be independent enough to stop traffic on the first unsafe trend and still preserve evidence if the DPU or host becomes unstable.
